verdicts.evidence: lines 477-492, 556-557, 606-609, 639-642, 688-696, 698-703, 754-767: every button (choose file, template, clear, check, cancel, import, back, downloads, filters, show more, stop, outcome actions) has a listener doing what its label names.

lines 566-638, 710-751: all counts, rows and statuses derive from the parsed input and api results; the only sample text is the textarea placeholder (line 167) showing the format. No hardcoded metrics or leftover text.

lines 568-577, 613-631: review shows the parsed rows and counts; line 593 import button names the count; line 650 run view shows done of total; lines 711-750 outcome shows imported, remaining and left-out counts.

Back keeps the textarea (line 640) and a failed check keeps it (lines 529-533), but there is no storage or URL state anywhere; line 772 always starts at step 1, so a reload loses the pasted list, the review results and the step.

line 598: preselected filter is a harmless view filter; no dialogs or Enter-default forms. Outcome primaries are safe: 'Check the list again' when saved count is unknown (line 761), resume from S.imported otherwise (lines 656-657, 764).
lines 154-237, 422-432: paste, check, review, import and outcome all run in one page as in-place views with no dialogs; the review step is the brief's required decision point before saving.

line 171 and 488: 'Download a blank template' matches no task in the brief (staff already have a spreadsheet export). Lines 196, 641, 765: CSV downloads of problem and unimported rows are also additions the brief did not name.

line 179: only Check is primary in step 1; line 194: only Import in review; run view has one plain button; lines 754-767: each outcome branch passes primary=true to exactly one actionBtn (755 uses !b).

line 172: Clear is a small link-style button away from the primary; line 220: Stop import is plain styled; lines 762, 767: 'Start a new import' is non-primary and last. No form or Enter default triggers any of them.

lines 593-594: disabled import button is relabelled 'Nothing to import' with line 572 text explaining every row has a problem. Lines 497-502: controls disabled during a check sit beside 'Checking N contacts'. Line 691: Stop disabled only for its own request.
No title attributes, tooltips or hover cards anywhere in the markup or script.

lines 142-237 and all script strings: text is about contacts, rows and the CRM; nothing mentions the build, framework, brief or mocked data. Raw error detail (lines 532, 741) is judged under COPY-011.

line 181 note sits at Check; line 221 at Stop import; line 216 keep page open during the run; lines 589, 721, 730, 758 notes sit in the view whose decision they inform (go ahead, re-check, fix left-out rows). Each maps to an action.

lines 156-157: 'Choose a CSV file exported from your spreadsheet, or paste the rows below' narrates the controls; line 143 describes what the page does; line 162 'or drop a file anywhere on this box'; line 470 'You can edit it below before checking'.

line 143 subtitle 'Add contacts to the CRM from a spreadsheet' restates h1 'Import contacts'; 'see problems before anything is saved' (143), 'Nothing is imported at this step' (181) and 'Nothing has been imported yet' (571, 573) say one thing three times.

lines 142-237, 568-573, 717-737: headings and messages are factual statements and counts; no greeting, slogan, superlative, congratulation or exclamation mark in any text string (the '!' at line 725 is an aria-hidden badge glyph).

Labels: 'Choose a CSV file', 'Check for problems', 'Import N contacts', 'Go back and edit the list', 'Download the N problem rows (CSV)', 'Stop import', 'Show N more', 'Import the remaining N', 'Start a new import'. 'Clear' and 'Cancel' have one object in view.

lines 505-511, 538, 545: server codes REQUIRED, EMAIL_FORMAT, PHONE_FORMAT, DUPLICATE_IN_CRM are mapped to plain phrases with a plain fallback; table headings are Row, Name, Email, Phone, Company, Status. Raw error detail is left to COPY-011.

lines 530-531 and 724-737 give a clear cause and next step, but lines 532 and 741 append the raw server message verbatim ('ECONNRESET: socket hang up while trying to validate import', 'ETIMEDOUT: upstream timed out during batch 5'), a library message, not a reference code.
line 732: heading 'The import failed. Nothing was imported' uses 'failed', which the rule excludes. Other messages are neutral (lines 367, 369, 385, 530, 724).

lines 403, 598, 604: review is only reached with at least one row, and the Problems and Ready filters are offered only when both groups are non-empty, so the table can never show zero items. No other list, feed or search exists.

lines 403, 604, 614: the only list cannot be empty for any reason (no rows blocks the check with an error; filters with zero matches are not rendered), so there are no competing empty causes to tell apart.

lines 524-533: after 3 failed validate attempts an inline alert says the check could not run, the list stays, with 'Try again'. Lines 678-685, 724-767: a failed import shows what was saved and offers 'Try again' or 'Import the remaining N'.

lines 494-503: check shows a spinner and 'Checking N contacts' at once, with a Cancel button (line 557). Lines 645-651, 669-673: import shows a progress bar and 'X of Y contacts imported'; lines 688-696 'Stop import' aborts via the signal.

lines 519-553: during the check the input view stays with a busy button; the review view and its counts render only after the response (renderReview then show). No empty-state text appears while waiting.

line 103 overflow-wrap:anywhere on cells; line 101 scroll wrapper; lines 116-127 stacked rows on narrow screens; line 623 blank optional values show 'none' or 'missing'; lines 296, 616, 633-637 page 200 rows with 'Show N more'; counts use toLocaleString.

line 652: beforeunload only prompts while S.running. A pasted and hand-edited list or a reviewed but not yet imported list is lost on closing or navigating away with no prompt, and nothing restores it (no storage; line 772 starts fresh).

lines 156-157 state before input that it must be CSV with first-row column names name, email, phone, company and that name and email are needed; line 167 placeholder shows the layout. (The 5 MB file limit, line 465, appears only on error.)

lines 160-167: the form has a single input (the CSV textarea, with file choice as an alternate way to fill it); there is no mix of required and optional form fields. Column requirements are stated in words at line 157.
lines 443-446: typing only updates a neutral count ('No contacts found yet.' / 'N contacts found.') and hides any error; errors are produced only in check() on pressing the button (lines 516-517).

line 176: the input error box sits directly under the textarea with bold text, border and background. In review, lines 620-627 flag the offending cell (tint plus underline) and put the problem text in that row's Status cell.
lines 516-517 and 529-533: a client or server rejection only shows the error box; csv.value is never cleared (readOnly is lifted at line 528), and the message says 'your list is still here'.

line 517 moves focus to the textarea on a client error, but the textarea never gets aria-invalid and its aria-describedby points only to csv-count (line 166), not to #input-error. On server failure (529-533) focus is not moved at all.

line 179: Check is enabled on load; pressing it empty shows 'Paste your contacts or choose a file first.' and focuses the field (lines 367, 517). It is disabled only while its own check is in flight (line 497).

line 514 'if (S.checking) return' plus disabled busy button (497-500); line 655 'if (S.running) return' and the view switches to the progress view at once (line 665), so a second press cannot start a second import.

line 519 sets the busy spinner label synchronously before the await; line 665 shows the progress view before the api call; lines 606-609 filters re-render at once; lines 691-694 Stop becomes 'Stopping' immediately.

lines 552-553 the check result is the review view; lines 710-751 the outcome view states imported, stopped or failed with counts; line 470 names the loaded file; failures are always stated (530, 724-737).
No toasts or success banners. The only success message is the outcome view (lines 716-718), reporting a server-side result not otherwise visible; line 470 names which file was loaded.

lines 447-457: errors render in the inline #input-error box with no timer; it is hidden only when the user edits the list or re-runs the check (445, 515). Outcome errors with their action buttons persist in the done view. No setTimeout dismissal exists.

lines 489-492: Clear wipes the textarea (a programmatic value set, so browser undo does not bring it back) with no undo control; lines 704-709 and 767: 'Start a new import' discards the list, including unimported rows, with no undo.

Import is the one irreversible write. The review step precedes it: lines 568-573 name how many contacts will be imported and how many left out, 'Nothing has been imported yet'; the button reads 'Import N contacts' beside 'Go back and edit the list' (593, 195); no Enter default.
No confirm(), dialog element or custom confirmation dialog in the file; the only prompt is the browser beforeunload guard during a running import (line 652).
No optimistic updates: review renders only after validateImport resolves (lines 525-553) and counts change only from server progress callbacks or results (lines 669-681).
No modal dialogs; all four views are in-page sections toggled by show() (lines 422-432).
No modal dialogs anywhere in the file.

lines 142-183: after the title and step list, the first block is the input card. In review (186-211) the outcome heading, counts and the import decision come first, then the row table defaulting to problem rows (line 598).
lines 142-154: an h1, one muted line and a compact three-step list precede the working card; no hero, greeting banner or introductory panel.

lines 574-577: 'ready to import' and 'rows with problems' inform whether to go ahead; lines 579-588 problem breakdown informs what to fix; lines 745-750 outcome tallies inform retry or download. No decorative metrics or charts.

lines 601-611: filter buttons carry text labels with counts ('Problems (3)', 'Ready (5)', 'All rows (8)') and a pressed state; 'All rows' clears the filter in one action; line 634 shows 'Showing X of N rows.' under the table.

All controls are native button elements (lines 160, 171-172, 179-180, 194-196, 208, 220, 605, 699); the hidden file input is opened by a real button (line 477); drag and drop is optional; :focus-visible is styled (line 70). No click-only divs.

line 627-628 status is text ('Ready' or the problem); line 107 flagged cells add an underline bar plus the status text and 'missing' label (623); badges use check and '!' glyphs (716, 725); tally numbers have text labels; error box has bold text.

line 151: #live role=status exists on load and say() fills it for checking, loaded file, review result, progress quarters, stopping and outcome (319, 471, 520, 554, 672, 686, 695); line 176 #input-error is role=alert present from load; progressbar has aria-valuenow.
No accordions, disclosure buttons, menus, comboboxes or tabs; the filter buttons are toggles with aria-pressed (lines 605-608) and 'Show N more' appends rows instead of opening a region.

line 5 viewport meta; lines 116-127 table rows become stacked label and value pairs under 640px; line 73 action buttons go full width under 520px; lines 39, 71, 90, 97 step list, rows, tallies and filters wrap; textarea is 100% wide; buttons min-height 44px.
